results.title: Drone Loop – Ambient Background Texture
results.author: kkenny101
results.description: A slowly evolving ambient drone texture generated with MANTICE by bassimat. The original sound was created procedurally with MANTICE and then processed with PaulStretch using small FFT window sizes and a moderate stretch factor of around 5x. The processing introduces subtle spectral beating, phase interactions, and evolving frequency movements. These effects add a more organic and imperfect character to the very clean original MANTICE sound, creating a slightly rougher, deeper and more textured ambient atmosphere. The result is a continuous drone texture with slowly shifting harmonic details, suitable for ambient music, soundscapes, cinematic backgrounds, meditation, and experimental audio projects. Source: A drone texture generated by MANTICE by bassimat Original preset/source: https://bassimatte.github.io/mantice/#shared=Photonic_Expanse_20260622_1413a0 Tools used: MANTICE – procedural ambient drone generator Web: https://bassimatte.github.io/mantice/ GitHub: https://github.com/bassimatte/mantice PaulStretch – spectral/time-stretch processing

results.title: High-Frequency Granular Pad with Eerie Tension
results.author: bassimat
results.description: A high-frequency granular pad suspended in an uneasy, constantly shifting state. Fine grains shimmer and scrape against each other, creating unstable harmonics and subtle dissonances. Suitable for suspense, horror, unsettling ambient environments and cinematic tension. Created with https://www.dawesomemusic.com/plugins/novum/

results.title: Granular Wavetable Drone (Seamlessly Loopable)
results.author: kkenny101
results.description: Raw drone created from a wavetable source and transformed using granular synthesis. To create this texture, the original sound was processed through a granular synthesizer to produce a deep, evolving atmosphere with subtle movement. The result was then carefully filtered, refined, and edited into a seamless loop, making it suitable for dark ambient, experimental music, sound design, games, and cinematic projects. Feel free to use it in your own music, films, games, or soundscapes. If you use it, I'd love to hear how it was used or receive any feedback. Source: https://freesound.org/people/CAT-FOX_ALEX/sounds/863929/

results.title: Resonating Ambient Drone with Distant Shimmering Voices
results.author: bassimat
results.description: A deep resonating drone with a soft pad that slowly changes in the background. Far away, shimmering voice-like sound appears and disappears, leaving long resonances that blend with the rest of the texture. Created in Ableton with sampling/resampling and effects from a ruler sound from the pack https://freesound.org/people/CAT-FOX_ALEX/packs/46157/?
